verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API described as the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without the web UI, which states UI parity directly. A separate HTTP API covers gate, config and experiment evaluation and event logging, and an official MCP server exposes Statsig to agent tools. The parity claim is only a one-line statement, and the OpenAPI probe found no machine-readable spec at common paths. missing for 10: per-feature evidence that API coverage spans all UI surfaces (e.g., Metrics Explorer, Session Replay, Warehouse Native), a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
